Dana, I couldn't find a settled seat count for the 2026 renewal in the documents I can see. The only figure is Ilse's post in this channel on 2026-10-14: 261 seats, presented as "for your records." I don't see a signed document that backs it up:

- The 2026 Renewal Order Form (signed 2026-03-20) doesn't state a seat count.
- Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) sets the subscribed seats at 230, effective 2027-01-01.
- The account page shows 185 active seats, last updated 2026-09-30.

Before you put a number in the tracker, I'd confirm the 261 with Ilse or June, since that's the figure the signed paperwork doesn't cover.
